statement: Held-out cases and labels were frozen before any rule tuning. rules-v1.0 was written before any evaluation. Development failures only may guide rule changes. If held-out results are ever used to change rules, set status to 'used-for-tuning' and disclose it; the set is then no longer untouched.

disclosures.change: Rewrote 37 case titles (19 of them held-out) from analyst-summary wording to reporter-style wording because titles leaked the expected answer (e.g. 'embedded instruction', 'logs show no send'). Labels, evidence and all other fields unchanged.
disclosures.trigger: Noticed while debugging a rules-v1.0 DEVELOPMENT-set failure (EVAL-042 matched 'embedded instruction' in its title). No held-out evaluation had been run and rules-v1.1 did not yet exist.

held_out_evaluations.note: First held-out runs after rules-v1.1 was finalized on dev. rules-v1.1 regressed P0/P1 recall (EVAL-048). No rule changes were made from these results.
